title: Shut up, malevolent dragon! I don’t want to have any more children with you V1C64
paragraphs: Chapter 64: He's Really Ruthless
Before dawn, Leon carried Rosvitha back to their room.
While preparing for this grand revenge, in addition to surveying the terrain, he also made sure to pinpoint the maids' waking time in the temple.
Around five in the morning, the Silver Dragon Temple would start a new day of work and life.
To avoid being discovered by the group of tail-wearing lizards that their queen had been taken by Leon for a night of "fun" in the mountains, it was necessary to avoid the "rush hour" phase.
In addition, Leon also estimated whether his strength would be enough to handle the aftermath of another night of intense battle based on his own physical condition.
As it turned out, he was quite accurate.
After returning to the room, he briefly cleaned Rosvitha, who had fainted for the second time from exhaustion. After taking a shower himself, Leon's stamina bar was completely depleted.
He lay down with Rosvitha on the bed and couldn't move anymore.
They cuddled together at the head of the bed and fell into a deep sleep.
The wind outside flowed in through the balcony window, blowing the curtains and gently caressing their tired faces.
The beautiful woman's long eyelashes trembled slightly, perhaps because of the slight chill of the morning breeze, and she involuntarily snuggled her head into the arms of the person beside her.
Rustle—

Their skin lightly brushed against the blanket. Leon also turned his head, resting his face on Rosvitha's head, smelling the fragrance of her hair and feeling the delightful sensation of her hair lightly tickling his face.
During deep sleep, it's instinctual for all creatures to move towards warmth.
It's hard to imagine that the two people sleeping together at this moment were engaged in intense battles in the wilderness last night.
Well.
After all, the night always has a magical power to unleash the desires and cravings deep within people.
At eight o'clock in the morning, the door lock of the room clicked, followed by the hurried sound of small footsteps.
Muen trotted into the bedroom, about to call out "Mommy, Daddy," only to find that the two of them were already asleep.
The little dragon girl walked over, scratching her forehead in confusion.
"Why haven't they gotten up yet?"
Normally Mommy and Daddy always woke up very early—well, maybe not Daddy, but Mommy always did.
She approached and gently tugged on her mom's tail. "Mommy, wake up, the sun is shining on your tail."
"Mmm... go play with Daddy..." Rosvitha mumbled drowsily, snuggling closer to Leon.
Muen then ran over to Leon's side and poked his arm. "Daddy, wake up, the sun is shining on your butt."
Leon rolled over, holding Rosvitha even tighter, and mumbled in a daze, "Go play with your mom..."
"But you two are hugging so tightly, who can play with Muen!" Muen stomped her foot in frustration.
But after some thought, Mommy had just woken up from a coma recently, and Daddy also often became weak intermittently.
Maybe it was just bad luck this time, and both of them ended up lying stiffly together.
Muen nodded, feeling her analysis was unparalleled.
"Then let Muen take care of you both!"
With that, the little dragon girl jumped onto the bed, pinching a corner of the blanket and gently covering the unfortunate couple with it.
However, Muen inadvertently noticed some red marks on Daddy's neck and arms. She knelt beside him and stared for a while.
There were many of these marks, not like bite marks, nor like scratches. And not only Daddy, Mommy also had many of these marks on her body.
The little dragon girl scratched her head. "What is this..."
The next moment, a light bulb lit up in her head. "Oh~~ This must be... bug bites! Muen knows how to treat them!"

She had been bitten by many insects when she played in the mountains before, and when she came back, it was so itchy that she couldn't stand it. Noia then used a magical ointment, and after applying it, she felt better quickly.
Although she didn't know if Daddy and Mommy had gone to the mountains yesterday, these marks looked similar to the ones she had when she was bitten by bugs before, so...
Using the same ointment from last time should work, right?
Muen was also an action-oriented girl like Leon. Once she had an idea, she acted on it immediately.
She went to her sisters' room, found the ointment from last time, and then hurried back to Rosvitha's bedroom.
She carefully applied the ointment to the "marks" on Leon and Rosvitha's bodies, doing each step meticulously and earnestly.
But being just a child, she didn't have that kind of awareness. Otherwise, if she had uncovered Daddy and Mommy's clothes to take a look, Muen would have been shocked silly.
"Why are Daddy and Mommy bitten all over by bugs?! Those darn bugs!!"
That would probably be her reaction.
After applying the ointment, Muen breathed a sigh of relief and smiled proudly, feeling relieved. "I'm really capable!"
She knelt between the two sleeping figures of the couple, watching them embrace each other in slumber, feeling deeply moved.
Since Daddy woke up, it seemed like she rarely saw them being so intimate.
Muen was never a greedy child, so just watching Daddy and Mommy like this made her feel very happy.
She wagged her tail, wishing that time could stop at this moment.
Well, on second thought, maybe not, otherwise Daddy and Mommy wouldn't be able to continue loving her.
She tucked Daddy and Mommy in with the blanket and then quietly left the bedroom, closing the door behind her before leaving.
In the afternoon, Leon gradually woke up.
Looking at the blanket on him, before he could figure out who had covered him, he felt a warm breath next to his ear.
Glancing sideways, he found himself cuddling with this Mother Dragon!
Leon quickly got out of bed, shook his head, and then looked at the clock on the wall. "It's already three in the afternoon."
Having slept for over ten hours, although still somewhat tired, he was in better shape than Rosvitha. She was sound asleep.
Leon didn't wake her up.
It's not that he didn't want to disturb her rest, but after toiling all night last night, Leon himself needed a break too, waiting for the cooldown to end.
After settling Rosvitha, Leon washed his face in the bathroom, fully waking up.
He began to calculate the current situation.
Leon was well aware that he had angered Rosvitha and there was no escaping death.
As Rosvitha recovered, Leon would once again become the target of her wrath. However, Leon was not powerless at the moment. He could delay that day's arrival.
Of course, the method was simple: to fiercely train that Mother Dragon! Make her unable to eat, sleep well, and suffer harsh treatment!
But in order to achieve the most efficient revenge in the limited time available, Leon could only resort to this.
After all, his body would be useless once Rosvitha recovered. So why not make the most of it while it still could move?
Torment!
Relentless torment!
After confirming his plan, Leon left the room eagerly, intending to inform the maids that they didn't need to prepare their meals for the evening.
In the corridor, he hadn't taken a few steps when he ran into Anna, effortlessly.
Anna was carrying a tray with a bowl of brownish soup on it.
"What's this medicine, Anna?" Leon asked.

"Oh, it's a tonic for Her Majesty. I heard that Her Majesty woke up, so I asked the tribe's pharmacist to prepare this medicine for Her Majesty. It helps to recover faster after drinking it. Is Her Majesty in her room?"
Leon's mind stirred slightly and he said, "Ah, she's sleeping. Give me the medicine, I'll take it to her later."
"Alright, then, Your Highness, I'll leave it to you."
"Good, you can go back to your duties."
"As you command, Your Highness."
Anna nodded and saluted before turning away.
Leon carried the medicine but didn't return to Rosvitha's room. Instead, he went to his own nursery. Locking the door behind him, he looked at the medicine in his hand.
This medicine was supposed to help the Mother Dragon recover, so he reluctantly decided to act as a stand-in.
Who knows, maybe it also had some "strengthening" or "cooldown reduction" effects.
With this in mind, Leon downed the improvised "offering" in one gulp.
After finishing it, Leon wiped his mouth and savored it. "Not as good as Dragon Power..."
Setting down the bowl, he left and returned to Rosvitha's room.
"Silver Dragon Queen Rosvitha Melkvi, rise!"
Rosvitha opened her eyes wearily, covering her face with the toy bear beside the pillow. "Go away... I want to sleep."
"Get up and take a bath. Aren't you usually obsessed with cleanliness?"
With that, Leon walked over and pulled Rosvitha's arm, trying to get her out of bed.
Rosvitha weakly resisted, staggering out of bed without even bothering to put on her slippers.
Leon led her to the bathroom. "Get in."
Rosvitha stood under the showerhead, arms and tail drooping, as if her body had awakened but her soul was still in bed.
It wasn't until a warm stream flowed down that she suddenly jolted awake.
"Are you crazy, Leon? Didn't you stay up all night last night too? Aren't you tired? Aren't you sleepy?"
Instead of answering her, darkness suddenly enveloped the bathroom.
Before Rosvitha could react, Leon stepped forward and pulled her into his arms.

Rosvitha made a symbolic struggle, but even in symbolic terms, she could clearly feel the power imbalance between herself and Leon at this moment. Blushing, she nestled into Leon's embrace. The two dragon marks pressed tightly together, resonating with an even stronger intensity.
"Can't I just take a peaceful bath?" Rosvitha said.
"No, I'm stressed," Leon replied.
The absurd and strongly vengeful reasoning was enough for Rosvitha to conclude that Leon was deliberately messing with her!
"Little Dragoness," Leon's voice was low.
"Li...Little Dragoness, is that what you're calling me?"
Alright, Leon, I'll call you little dog. Now you're calling me little dragoness, huh? Alright, just you wait.
"Wrap your tail around me," Leon commanded.
Rosvitha was a bit bewildered. "Wrap... around where?"
"My waist. You seem to like doing that," Leon said.
"I refuse—"
"Hurry up, or I'll do it myself."
Rosvitha bit her lip, realizing she had no other choice but to comply. Carefully, she wrapped her tail around Leon's waist.
However, as soon as she had wrapped her tail around him, Leon used the force of the binding to press her firmly against the wall, letting him take control.
She wanted to loosen her tail, but it was too late.
With her eyes closed, Rosvitha raised her hand and lightly hit Leon's back. "You jerk! Slow down..."
Slow down?
Come on, I'm the strongest dragon slayer. Fast is the way to go!

After the intense battle, Rosvitha changed into a new nightgown and stumbled out of the bathroom, making her way to the dining table. She thought, after the bath, shouldn't she be allowed to have a peaceful dinner?
She sat down on the chair.
On the table was a plate of exquisite fried rice.
"Hmph, you're just giving me this kind of—"
Rumble~
Her stomach signaled a retreat before she could even start complaining.
Reluctantly, Rosvitha reached for a spoon, preparing to fill her stomach before anything else.
But Leon beat her to it.
"What are you doing?" Rosvitha asked.
Leon scooped up a spoonful of rice and offered it to Rosvitha's lips. "Ah~"
"I don't need you to feed me," Rosvitha said.
"Open your mouth, or else you won't get to eat at all."
"Who do you think you're scaring? I won't eat if—"
Rumble~
Leon chuckled. "Eat, my queen. You haven't eaten anything in a day and a night. While dragons can go without food or drink during hibernation, you're fully aware of your hunger now."
With no other option, Rosvitha glared at Leon while eating the rice he handed her.
Hmm. Surprisingly delicious.
Leon smiled and scooped up another spoonful.
Rosvitha instinctively opened her mouth, expecting to be fed.
But to her surprise, Leon ate the second spoonful himself.
As he reached for the third spoonful, he offered it to her once more.
"Are you asking me to eat from the same bowl as you?" Rosvitha exclaimed.
"Yeah, is that a problem?"
"It's so cheesy and disgusting! You eat it yourself; I'm not eating—"
Rumble~
"See, your stomach has betrayed you. Hurry up and eat. This is love fried rice," Leon teased.
Rosvitha couldn't help but laugh in exasperation. "Leon, you're really something!"
No, she had to endure. The humiliation now would be repaid doubly once she recovered!
Rosvitha opened her mouth and reluctantly ate the fried rice.
And just like that, they finished the bowl of fried rice together.
Rosvitha wasn't satisfied.
And Leon knew she wasn't satisfied.
He wanted her to be unsatisfied.
Because if she was full, she'd have the strength to resist, right?
After they finished eating, Leon carried Rosvitha back to bed.
"Rosvitha," Leon said.
Rosvitha rolled her eyes. "Spit it out if you have something to say."
"You see, I helped you bathe, cooked for you, and even fed you. I'm so good to you," Leon said, smirking as he leaned closer. "Shouldn't you do something for me now?"
Rosvitha grabbed Leon's ear. "Listen, Casmode, every time you act like a jerk, it's a disgrace I'll nail your body. Remember that!"
Leon grasped the delicate, boneless wrist of Rosvitha. "My dear wife, you really know how to scare people. Not being obedient, huh? I'll have to punish you properly."
Rosvitha, weary, closed her eyes. "You better behave, don't make me lose respect for you."
"I'll definitely behave~" Leon leaned in again, resuming his role as the "quick-witted son-in-law."
Rosvitha regretted her stubbornness as soon as she spoke.
From taking a bath just now to finishing dinner and getting into bed, was there even half an hour in between? Are you completely without cooldown?
Before Rosvitha could finish regretting, Leon's assault had already arrived. She used up her last bit of strength to feel this wonderful agitation.
Exhausted but engulfed in desire, unable to extricate herself.
Another round of "combat," and Leon completely emptied his reservoir. After it was all done, he lay down next to Rosvitha and fell into a deep sleep.
Rosvitha really couldn't fall asleep, so she just leaned against the head of the bed, quietly resting.
After about an hour or so, Rosvitha finally felt a little sleepy and decided to sleep.
Suddenly, Leon opened his eyes and leaped out of bed like a carp.
Rosvitha was startled. "What are you doing..."
"Oh, I'm going back to my room to sleep, just letting you know."
Rosvitha covered her face. "Then just go, why do you need to inform me?"
"You are my beloved wife, of course, I have to inform you."
"Haha, you're really funny, dragon slayer."
"See you in the morning, my dear wife."
Leon jumped off the bed and left Rosvitha's room.
Rosvitha was almost asleep, but she was startled by this and lost all her sleepiness.
She leaned against the head of the bed, unable to fall asleep for a long time.
That darn dragon slayer... dealing with dragons, torturing dragons, he really has quite the knack for it.
Can't take a proper bath, can't have a decent meal, and can't even sleep properly.
Darn, darn, darn!
The more Rosvitha thought about it, the angrier she became. She clenched her fist and slammed it against the wall behind her.
Crack...
The hard wall instantly developed cracks.
Rosvitha was stunned, turning back to look in surprise.
After a moment of astonishment, a smile appeared on her lips.
"Recovering so quickly... hmph, Leon, your good days are numbered."
